newsitem.title: UK: British Investment sells Edinburgh stake.
newsitem.headline: British Investment sells Edinburgh stake.

text.p: British Investment Trust Plc said on Friday it has completed agreements which will have the effect of it selling its 32.5 percent stake in Edinburgh Fund Managers.

BIT said it has placed 7.53 million shares in Edinburgh with HSBC James Capel at 565p per share and a conditional buy-back agreement to sell 2.645 million Edinburgh shares to Edinburgh at the same price.
Both deals are subject to the approval of Edinburgh shareholders who will meet for an EGM on April 7.

BIT first announced the share sale on Tuesday as part of a restructuring following a decision by its biggest shareholder, British Coal Pension Scheme, that it should not hold such a large proportion of its assets in a quoted investment trust.
